summary: This React component renders a share button that lets users post the current article to Bluesky social media. It checks that the article has required metadata (title and URL) before generating a share link, and returns nothing if those details are missing or if the article already has a Bluesky record.

explanations.3: This imports two translation utilities from Docusaurus — the Translate component for wrapping text that needs internationalization, and the translate function for programmatically generating translated strings like the button's accessibility label.
explanations.4: This hook gives the component access to the Docusaurus site configuration, which includes the site's base URL needed to construct the full share link.
explanations.20: This safely extracts the Bluesky record key from nested metadata using optional chaining, returning undefined if any level doesn't exist rather than throwing an error.
explanations.22: This returns early with nothing rendered if a Bluesky record key already exists, meaning the article has already been shared to Bluesky so we don't need to show the share button.
explanations.29: This constructs a Bluesky share intent URL by concatenating the base compose URL with URL-encoded versions of the article title and permalink, separated by a space.
explanations.31: The siteConfig.url provides the domain (like 'example.com'), and encodeURIComponent ensures that special characters in the title and permalink don't break the URL.
